ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white pixel regions across both lateral lobes; centralized irregular dark geometric cluster at the fluke-peduncle interface; narrow, non-uniform dark pixel banding along the posterior trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 65 degrees and a moderate vertical depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased amplitude at distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve profile fitted along the trailing edge from the median notch to the lateral distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular, high-intensity pixel groups (barnacle growth) localized on the right distal trailing edge and sporadically along the posterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy localized barnacle colonization on the distal margins of both fluke lobes; irregular fragmentation of dark pigmentation at the fluke-peduncle junction.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct 'islands' of white pixels interspersed within the centralized dark pigmentation region.
